milestone: Milestones 2–3 — V1-safe lifecycle and manager cutover

rollback.scope: Bundled plugins use one lifecycle manager. Recover through startup safe mode or a previously reviewed host build; retain plugin packages and settings.
procedure: Set OR3_DISABLE_NON_CORE_PLUGINS=true outside the plugin UI and restart before discovery.
Use the documented deployment rollback workflow if the host build must be restored.
Exercise the maintained plugin corpus before turning safe mode off and restarting.
Package pointer rollback still requires server promotion preflight and does not restore incompatible migrated state.
rollback.drill: The bundled workspace entry-point tests exercise unchanged register(api) modules, sequential startup, async cleanup, workspace transitions, logout, and startup safe mode. Former manager selection flags do not switch the bundled lifecycle.
